pages.title: 01 // BEYOND VIDEO RENDERING
pages.content:
You generated a cool 3D map video clip. Now what? You still have to drag it into Premiere Pro. You still have to manually type location markers. You still have to write bilingual subtitles line by line.

You still have to write social media captions and YouTube chapter timestamps. Generating a video file without editor assets solves only 20% of the problem. Content creators need turn-key editing packs, not isolated video clips.

pages.title: 02 // THE NLE ASSET DELIVERY PACK
pages.content:
VibePath turns field telemetry into an integrated NLE Asset Delivery Pack:
1. 4K/60FPS 3D Map MP4 Video in brand colors.
2. XMEML Timeline File (.xml) for Premiere, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut to auto-place POI markers.
3. Bilingual Subtitles (.srt) timed to ±0.02s with natural Vietnamese-English translations generated by Dify AI.
4. Social Media AI Copy with formatted YouTube chapters and viral hashtags.

pages.title: 03 // THE 3-TIER ENTERPRISE BACKBONE
pages.content:
Behind the Cybernetic Swiss Brutalism UI sits a decoupled 3-tier cloud architecture:

• Client Tier: React 18, Mapbox GL JS v3, and MediaRecorder running on Cloudflare Workers edge.
• Orchestration Tier: n8n workflows routing GPS payloads through Python geometry servers and Dify AI reasoning cores over Cloudflare Zero-Trust Tunnels.
• Storage Tier: Supabase PostgreSQL tracking trip logs while Cloudflare R2 delivers zip packages.
